headline: Central Bank of Peru Sets December 23 Pilot Launch for Tapp Payment Platform
summary: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru's official pilot for its payment platform Tapp is scheduled to start on December 23, following a limited friends-and-family trial involving four entities.
why: Central bank digital payment infrastructure initiatives aim to enhance retail payment efficiency, promote financial inclusion, and alter domestic transaction ecosystems.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Deployment of central bank payment systems modernizes domestic financial infrastructure.
